data.raw_text:
Fung-wong has rapidly intensified to a large Category 2 typhoon. Several VHTs have wrapped around its eye as the storm heads west-northwest under warm 29-30°C SST and relatively low wind shear. Fung-wong is forecast to continue rapid intensification throughout Saturday in favorable conditions. Although easterly wind shear is expected to increase, the storm's movement should abate some shear, and the storm would not weaken much.

Typhoon Fung-wong is forecast to peak as a high-end Category 4 typhoon, though a Category 5 typhoon scenario is plausible. Multiple models, including EC-AIFS, have shown a concerning southern trend with Fung-wong's track, which will impact areas such as Catanduanes, Camarines Norte, and Central Luzon. Residents in northern and central Philippines should rush preparations to completion, and this storm is expected to make landfall in Luzon, Philippines, on Sunday. Residents should heed strong wind gusts, life-threatening storm surge, and widespread flooding. Stay safe, everyone!

To everyone in Philippines especially in the affected locations/ares  please please do stay safe during this period of time 🙏🙏
Please make sure you know your evacuation routes just in case and please take care and stay safe and keep close with the updates 🥺

1)Monitor Updates:  Follow local news and weather updates and guidance through PAGASA and other reliable sources, including your local municipality’s Facebook page.
2)Prepare for Flooding:  Keep important documents in waterproof containers, stock up on essentials, and ensure you have access to clean water and food supplies.
3) Know Your Evacuation Routes:  Be aware of evacuation zones and routes in your area, especially if you are in flood-prone or landslide-susceptible regions.  Follow local evacuation orders.
4) Stay Safe Indoors:  During severe weather, avoid unnecessary travel and stay indoors unless directed otherwise by local authorities.  Avoid flood waters, which may carry life-threatening diseases and subject you to dangerous currents.
